Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Hibernation
Cards.Text: Open: Bow your performing Nonhuman: It hibernates. Negate its straightening until your next turn begins. After the next time this game another player's Battle action targets it, negate the action's effects.

Cards.Name: Visitation
Cards.Text:
Open: Destroy your performing Ancestor Personality to bow a target Personality. Negate his straightening until after you reveal cards in your Provinces at the start of your next turn.
Limited: If you control an Ancestor Personality, gain 2 Honor. Each player who does not control an Ancestor Personality loses 2 Honor.
